story.body: You said you will not come at Christmas, that the letter is unsealed, and that Hobbins cords it Thursday. You named the russet and withheld Joan's. She refused a pie made on a rumour, and she refused to repeat last Sunday's sentence. Master Thwaite did not ask for the letter.

title: Told Mistress Ansell Christmas is at Richmond
